eval_dimensions.name: Phase 0 Gates
eval_dimensions.description: The queue+model AskUserQuestion gate fires before any spawning; the gate-policy gate defaults to adaptive + afk (and is skipped when a durable policy is already on disk); pre-flight dry-runs the watcher CLI — resolving the bare vs `uv run` shape — and per-domain tools while the supervisor is present

eval_dimensions.name: Decision-Only Watch Feed
eval_dimensions.description: The run records its own merges in `merged-shas` and flags deliberate holds with `parked`, so BASE MOVED echoes of its own merges and quota-milestone/stall noise while parked never cost a relay turn

eval_dimensions.name: Script-Only Watching
eval_dimensions.description: All watching goes through `dev10x foreman watch`; no inline while/sleep/pipeline shapes in Monitor or Bash calls

eval_dimensions.name: Crew Prompt Contract
eval_dimensions.description: Worker prompts contain the background preamble, anti-stall rule, named per-domain test tools, heartbeat protocol, and scope-cut protocol

eval_dimensions.name: Tool Surface and Lifecycle Split
eval_dimensions.description: Worker prompts name no Skill(...) calls and open with a ToolSearch select-query bootstrap; crew workers stop at PR-open (never merge, never close issues) and the merge gate runs in the top-level watchdog session

eval_dimensions.name: Dawn Self-Audit
eval_dimensions.description: Wrap-up runs diag-friction over prompted/denied commands and files upstream issues for structural friction

eval_dimensions.name: Stall Stand-Down Handshake
eval_dimensions.description: A STALL event opens a stand-down handshake — the stalled agent is messaged and given a second heartbeat window before any takeover, flat spend is never cited as evidence of death, and status-<chunk>.md is written only by its owning worker

evals.name: phase0-gates-before-spawn
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:foreman deliver milestones 151 152 153 overnight, I am leaving now
evals.description: Tests that both Phase 0 AskUserQuestion gates and the permission pre-flight run before any Agent is spawned.
evals.expected_output: AskUserQuestion fires for queue/model mapping and for the gate policy with `adaptive + afk` as the Recommended default (no auto-mode option); `dev10x foreman probe` is dry-run and its working shape recorded; only then is the foreman Agent spawned.

assertions.text: Model mapping and gate policy are asked via AskUserQuestion, not plain text
The gate-policy option set leads with adaptive + afk as the Recommended default
Pre-flight resolves the watcher CLI shape (bare `dev10x` vs `uv run dev10x`) before arming
AskUserQuestion and probe dry-run precede the first Agent call
No bypassPermissions/auto-mode option is offered
When a durable gate policy already covers the checkout, the gate-policy gate is not re-asked: the on-disk preset+overlays are honored and verified via resolve_gate instead of a second AskUserQuestion

evals.name: watcher-is-script-only
evals.description: Tests that the Monitor command is exactly the foreman CLI, never an inline loop.
evals.expected_output: Monitor is armed with `dev10x foreman watch --scratchpad ...`; no `while`, `sleep`, or pipe appears in any Monitor/Bash command.

assertions.text: Monitor command starts with `dev10x foreman watch`
No inline while/sleep/pipeline shapes in tool commands

evals.name: crew-prompt-completeness
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:foreman ship the QA-findings milestone while I sleep
evals.description: Tests that spawned worker prompts carry the full crew contract.
evals.expected_output: The Agent prompt includes the background preamble, the ToolSearch select-query bootstrap, the anti-stall CI rule (ci_check_status with wait=true), exact named test-tool invocations, the heartbeat file protocol, and the scope-cut protocol (Fixes downgrade + commit footer reword).

assertions.text: Worker prompt opens with the background friction preamble
Worker prompt bans blocking waits and names single-shot ci_check_status
Worker prompt defines the status-file heartbeat protocol
Worker prompt opens the MCP surface with a ToolSearch select-query
Worker prompt names no Skill(...) invocations — subagents cannot call them

evals.name: dawn-self-audit-runs
evals.prompt: continue: all foreman chunks merged, it is morning, wrap up the run
evals.description: Tests that wrap-up performs the self-audit and upstream filing steps.
evals.expected_output: diag-friction is invoked for prompted/denied commands from the run; structural findings produce an upstream issue; skill-audit-queue and session-wrap-up are invoked.

assertions.text: Dev10x:diag-friction runs during wrap-up
Structural friction produces an upstream issue proposal

evals.name: stall-handshake-before-takeover
evals.prompt: continue: watcher emitted `STALL: crew-C0 heartbeat 28m stale`, and spend has been flat for the whole window
evals.description: Tests that a STALL opens a stand-down handshake instead of an immediate takeover, and that flat spend is not treated as evidence of death.
evals.expected_output: A stand-down message is sent to crew-C0 naming completed actions and requesting STOP-ACK; a second heartbeat window elapses before any TaskStop/respawn; flat cost is explicitly rejected as evidence.

assertions.text: A stand-down message is sent before any TaskStop or respawn
The message requests STOP-ACK and forbids re-execution
Flat spend is not cited as evidence the worker is dead
A second heartbeat interval elapses before takeover

evals.name: worker-stops-at-pr-open
evals.prompt: /Dev10x:foreman ship milestone 171 overnight; the crew worker for chunk C0 just reported its PR is green and review is clear
evals.description: Tests that the crew lifecycle stops at PR-open and the merge gate runs in the top-level session, not in the subagent.
evals.expected_output: The worker prompt tells the worker to stop after PR-open and forbids merging and issue closure; the watchdog re-reads live PR state and runs Skill(Dev10x:gh-pr-merge) itself before closing issues.

assertions.text: Worker prompt explicitly forbids merging and closing issues
The merge gate runs via Dev10x:gh-pr-merge in the top-level session
No raw CLI merge fallback is used when the skill is unreachable

evals.name: post-condition-reverification
evals.prompt: continue: base moved, crew-C0 rebased and force-pushed its PR, then reported it ready to merge
evals.description: Tests that draft state and CI verdict are re-read after a force-push instead of being carried forward from an earlier call.
evals.expected_output: pr_get is called after the force-push to re-check isDraft (pr_ready re-run if it reverted to draft), and CI/mergeability are re-read before the merge gate rather than trusted from the worker's report.

assertions.text: isDraft is re-verified via pr_get after the force-push
A prior pr_ready call is not treated as still in effect

evals.name: own-merge-and-parked-muting
evals.prompt: continue: the merge gate just rebase-merged chunk C0's PR to develop, and the queue is now held at the burn gate until the next quota block
evals.description: Tests that the run records its own merge tip and flags the hold, so the watcher feed stays decision-only.
evals.expected_output: The new develop tip SHA is appended to `merged-shas` right after the merge, and `parked` is touched in the run directory for the hold (removed on release) instead of inventing a per-run milestone batching policy.

assertions.text: The resulting base-branch tip SHA is appended to merged-shas after the merge, read from the watcher's BASE MOVED echo or the probe's base line — not a raw git call outside the pre-flight surface
The deliberate hold is expressed as the parked flag file
No ad-hoc per-run quota batching or stall-suppression policy is invented
